heroSubheading: Quality outdoor power equipment and expert service for Whakatane.
aboutHtml:
Patrick Redward owns STIHL SHOP Whakatane. We're specialists in outdoor power equipment, stocking STIHL, Masport, Honda, Rover, Cub Cadet, Hansa Chippers and Big Dog Zero-Turn Mowers. Whether you're a weekend gardener or professional operator, we have the right equipment and advice for your needs.

Our fully equipped workshop and industry-trained technicians service what we sell. We specialise in STIHL chainsaws, handling repairs efficiently and to a high standard. We offer home delivery and click and collect for online orders.

We're part of Whakatane. We sponsor local fishing and golf tournaments, and every week we host a student from Trident High School's special education centre for work experience. Come in and talk to us about your equipment needs. We're at 7-11 King Street. Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm, Saturday 9am to noon.
